message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc')
for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
    if 'XRefEntry::setFlag' in l or 'getFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing)' in l:
        print(i,l)
PY

cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz/pdf_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"data,size","code":"poppler::document::load_from_raw_data((const char *)data, size)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are handed to Poppler as a PDF document buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::scanSpecialFlags","line":1632,"var":"xrefStreamObjNums / trailerDict","code":"scanSpecialFlags()","note":"The document scan marks special xref-related objects before normal fetching, including objects referenced from the Encrypt dictionary."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::markUnencrypted","line":1671,"var":"trailerDict.dictLookupNF(\"Encrypt\")","code":"Object obj = trailerDict.dictLookupNF(\"Encrypt\");","note":"The trailer's Encrypt entry is read without dereferencing, so a crafted reference can steer which object is marked unencrypted."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::markUnencrypted","line":1676,"var":"e->flags","code":"e->setFlag(XRefEntry::Unencrypted, true);","note":"The referenced xref entry is tagged Unencrypted, changing later fetch behavior for that object."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::fetch","line":1131,"var":"parser->getObj(false, (encrypted && !e->getFlag(XRefEntry::Unencrypted)) ? fileKey : nullptr, ...)","code":"Object obj = parser->getObj(false, (encrypted && !e->getFlag(XRefEntry::Unencrypted)) ? fileKey : nullptr, encAlgorithm, keyLength, num, gen, recursion);","note":"When the marked object is fetched, Poppler skips decryption because the Unencrypted flag is set."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::getObj","line":204,"var":"entry->flags","code":"if (!entry->getFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing) || (objNum == 0 && objGen == 0)) { entry->setFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing, true); }","note":"Parsing state is set while the object is being decoded, so recursive references can re-enter the same object stream path."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":204,"var":"entry->setFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing, true)","code":"if (!entry->getFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing) || (objNum == 0 && objGen == 0)) { entry->setFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing, true); }","note":"The stream parser marks the current xref entry as actively parsing before consuming stream bytes."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":214,"var":"dict.dictLookup(\"Length\", recursion)","code":"Object obj = dict.dictLookup(\"Length\", recursion);","note":"The stream length is attacker-controlled through the PDF dictionary and determines how far the parser advances."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":257,"var":"length / pos","code":"lexer->setPos(pos + length);","note":"The parser skips over the declared stream payload using the crafted length, which can desynchronize tokenization."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":260,"var":"buf1,buf2","code":"shift();  // kill '>>'","note":"After the skip, token buffers are refilled from the new position, so malformed stream boundaries affect subsequent object parsing."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"ObjectStream::ObjectStream","line":162,"var":"obj1,obj2","code":"obj1 = parser->getObj(); obj2 = parser->getObj();","note":"Object-stream headers are parsed from attacker-controlled bytes, producing object numbers and offsets used for later object extraction."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"ObjectStream::ObjectStream","line":200,"var":"objs[i]","code":"objs[i] = parser->getObj();","note":"Each embedded object is parsed from the crafted object stream and stored for later fetches."},
  {"step":13,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::fetch","line":1163,"var":"objStr->getObject(e->gen, num)","code":"return objStr->getObject(e->gen, num);","note":"A compressed xref entry resolves through the object stream, returning the parsed embedded object to the caller."},
  {"step":14,"file":"src-vul/poppler/poppler/XRef.cc","function":"XRef::fetch","line":1131,"var":"obj","code":"Object obj = parser->getObj(...);","note":"The final object is materialized from the crafted stream/object-stream path and can carry malformed internal state into later consumers."}
]
JSON
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz/pdf_fuzzer.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
